text:
[Council File 25-1083-S2]
Motion (Yaroslavsky - Blumenfield, et al.) relative to: 1) directing the Department of City Planning (DCP) to develop and present to the Planning and Land Use Management (PLUM) Committee, a package of technical amendments to streamline development projects presented under Senate Bill (SB) 79, the amendments shall be designed to establish regulatory certainty and accelerate project approvals from the program's inception, and to align with and incorporate the City’s Missing Middle LA; and 2) directing the DCP, in coordination with the Department of Building and Safety (DBS) and any other relevant city departments, to report to the PLUM Committee with a comprehensive strategy to accompany the implementation; and related matters.
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
Against:
Westside Neighborhood Council
For:
North Westwood Neighborhood Council
summary: Motion directing Planning to bring technical amendments to speed up approvals of projects under state Senate Bill 79, aligned with Missing Middle LA, and asking for a broader implementation strategy with Building and Safety.

details.action: motion directing amendments and implementation report

outcome.text: Planning and Land Use Management Committee noted and filed item(s) (Oct 13, 2026)
